title_zh: Feast 代码库内部导航图
tagline_zh: 被问 feast apply 怎么跑、registry 存哪、物化怎么搬数据？不用翻源码。
tagline_en: Asked how feast apply works, where registry stores, how materialization moves data? Skip source-diving—this map.
desc_en: Internals of the Feast codebase — how each component works, where the key abstractions live, and the data flow through the system. Use when asked how feast apply works, how the registry stores data, how materialization moves data, how get_online_features retrieves features, how the feature server works, how the Kubernetes operator manages deployments, or when navigating the codebase to understand
why_zh: 不是文档复述，是代码解剖。按数据流串起 apply、registry、物化、在线检索。
why_en: Not doc rehash—code anatomy. Traces data flow through apply, registry, materialization, online retrieval, server, operator, so.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Feast 代码库内部机制，不含用法教程或部署指南；需要你本地有 Feast 源码副本才能对照阅读。
limit_en: Covers only Feast codebase internals, not usage or deployment guides; requires local Feast source to follow along; no feature-engineering concepts.
title_en: Feast codebase internals: from apply to online features
